scope: A reviewed subset of products supported by the WOOF WRF-history import path. Product membership is source-capability metadata, not forecast-skill or GPU qualification. The renderer still checks actual saved fields and complete time windows.

10m_wind_1h_max.input_note: the top-of-hour 10 m wind speed, hypot(u_10m, v_10m), at F003 (the history stores no sub-hourly 10 m wind maximum there (neither wind_speed_10m_max_1h nor WRF WSPD10MAX), so the wind between its hourly writes is not seen: a lower bound on the window's maximum, not the maximum)

10m_wind_run_max.input_note: the largest top-of-hour 10 m wind speed, hypot(u_10m, v_10m), over the run at F001, F002, F003 (the history stores no sub-hourly 10 m wind maximum there (neither wind_speed_10m_max_1h nor WRF WSPD10MAX), so the wind between its hourly writes is not seen: a lower bound on the window's maximum, not the maximum)

10m_wind_speed_and_direction.input_note: 10m AGL Wind Speed and Direction [fill: wind_speed_10m_agl]

200mb_rh_height_winds.input_note: isobaric chart cut from the stored isobaric volumes; no window requirement recorded, so it is priced at the most conservative recorded basis of zero hours

200mb_temperature_height_winds.input_note: isobaric chart cut from the stored isobaric volumes; no window requirement recorded, so it is priced at the most conservative recorded basis of zero hours

250mb_height_winds.input_note: isobaric chart cut from the stored isobaric volumes; no window requirement recorded, so it is priced at the most conservative recorded basis of zero hours

250mb_temperature_height_winds.input_note: isobaric chart cut from the stored isobaric volumes; no window requirement recorded, so it is priced at the most conservative recorded basis of zero hours

2m_temp_0_24h_max.input_note: A complete hourly history window through the stated duration is required.

2m_temp_0_24h_min.input_note: A complete hourly history window through the stated duration is required.

300mb_height_winds.input_note: isobaric chart cut from the stored isobaric volumes; no window requirement recorded, so it is priced at the most conservative recorded basis of zero hours

300mb_rh_height_winds.input_note: isobaric chart cut from the stored isobaric volumes; no window requirement recorded, so it is priced at the most conservative recorded basis of zero hours

300mb_temperature_height_winds.input_note: isobaric chart cut from the stored isobaric volumes; no window requirement recorded, so it is priced at the most conservative recorded basis of zero hours

500mb_rh_height_winds.input_note: isobaric chart cut from the stored isobaric volumes; no window requirement recorded, so it is priced at the most conservative recorded basis of zero hours

500mb_temperature_height_winds.input_note: isobaric chart cut from the stored isobaric volumes; no window requirement recorded, so it is priced at the most conservative recorded basis of zero hours

700mb_dewpoint_height_winds.input_note: isobaric chart cut from the stored isobaric volumes; no window requirement recorded, so it is priced at the most conservative recorded basis of zero hours

850mb_dewpoint_height_winds.input_note: isobaric chart cut from the stored isobaric volumes; no window requirement recorded, so it is priced at the most conservative recorded basis of zero hours

850mb_rh_height_winds.input_note: isobaric chart cut from the stored isobaric volumes; no window requirement recorded, so it is priced at the most conservative recorded basis of zero hours

qpf_1h.input_note: 1 h APCP differenced from stored run-total accumulations (F003 minus F002); this store carries no native apcp_1h plane

qpf_6h.input_note: A complete hourly history window through the stated duration is required.

uh_2to5km_run_max.input_note: run max of stored sub-hourly 1 h max 2-5 km UH planes (WRF UP_HELI_MAX per-history-interval max at F001, F002, F003: reset at each history write, so this is the exact trailing 1 h max when history is written hourly; a run with sub-hourly history is exact only when rendered with its frames between the hours)

heat_index_2m.input_note: NWS Steadman/Rothfusz screen heat index, degC; T2, Q2 and PSFC.

apparent_temperature_2m.input_note: NWS heat-index/wind-chill/air-temperature convention, degC; screen thermodynamics and 10 m wind.

wetbulb_2m.input_note: Thermodynamic screen wet bulb, degC; T2, Q2 and PSFC.

fire_weather_composite.input_note: Screen wind times vapor-pressure deficit; instantaneous composite, not Canadian FWI.

wbgt_2m.input_note: Liljegren sensor balances, degC; SWDOWN, screen fields and native temperature/height profiles.

hot_dry_windy.input_note: Independent maximum wind and surface-adjusted VPD in the lowest 500 m; instantaneous hPa m/s.

haines_low.input_note: Haines 950/850 hPa stability plus 850 hPa dewpoint-depression categories; below-terrain surfaces remain missing.

haines_mid.input_note: Haines 850/700 hPa stability plus 850 hPa dewpoint-depression categories; below-terrain surfaces remain missing.

haines_high.input_note: Haines 700/500 hPa stability plus 700 hPa dewpoint-depression categories; below-terrain surfaces remain missing.

lightning_threat_1.input_note: Experimental McCaul updraft/graupel proxy at -15 degC; native microphysics required; flashes/km2/5min.

lightning_threat_2.input_note: Experimental McCaul ice-column proxy; graupel, snow and cloud ice required; flashes/km2/5min.

lightning_threat_3.input_note: Experimental McCaul 0.95 LTG1 + 0.05 LTG2 blend; native microphysics required; flashes/km2/5min.

pr92_flash_rate.input_note: Experimental WRF PR92 domain-wide maximum updraft and widest >20 dBZ echo area; flashes/s/cell.

vpd_2m.input_note: 2 m vapor-pressure deficit in hPa, calculated in Rust from native WRF T2, Q2 and PSFC using the surface thermodynamics kernel.

2m_vpd_0_24h_max.input_note: max of stored vpd_2m in hPa over every hourly snapshot F001-F024; missing hours block the window.

2m_vpd_0_24h_min.input_note: min of stored vpd_2m in hPa over every hourly snapshot F001-F024; missing hours block the window.

2m_vpd_0_24h_range.input_note: range of stored vpd_2m in hPa over every hourly snapshot F001-F024; missing hours block the window.

unavailable.10m_wind_gusts: The wind maximum uses stored 10 m wind snapshots. It is not a gust diagnostic; gust magnitude or a gust swath requires separate analysis or observations.
unavailable.categorical_freezing_rain: Precipitation-type categories are not supplied by the current WOOF history renderer. Temperature and moisture plots provide environmental context; rain/snow/freezing-rain/ice-pellet classification requires separate analysis or observations.
unavailable.categorical_ice_pellets: Precipitation-type categories are not supplied by the current WOOF history renderer. Temperature and moisture plots provide environmental context; rain/snow/freezing-rain/ice-pellet classification requires separate analysis or observations.
unavailable.categorical_snow: Precipitation-type categories are not supplied by the current WOOF history renderer. Temperature and moisture plots provide environmental context; rain/snow/freezing-rain/ice-pellet classification requires separate analysis or observations.
unavailable.cloud_cover: The requested cloud panel shows low, middle and high layer cloud cover. It does not calculate total cloud fraction.
unavailable.dcape: The current WOOF history renderer does not produce DCAPE. Moisture and temperature context cannot establish downdraft energy; that parcel calculation requires separate analysis.
unavailable.dewpoint_depression_2m: Air temperature and dewpoint are shown separately. Dewpoint depression is not calculated by this history-rendering path and requires separate analysis.
unavailable.lapse_rate_0_3km: The stored 0-3 km lapse-rate plot uses plain temperature. It is not the virtual-temperature lapse rate; the virtual-temperature quantity requires separate analysis.
unavailable.lapse_rate_700_500: The stored 700-500 hPa lapse-rate plot uses plain temperature. It is not the virtual-temperature lapse rate; the virtual-temperature quantity requires separate analysis.
unavailable.precipitation_type: Precipitation-type categories are not supplied by the current WOOF history renderer. Temperature and moisture plots provide environmental context; rain/snow/freezing-rain/ice-pellet classification requires separate analysis or observations.
unavailable.simulated_ir_satellite: Simulated infrared brightness temperature needs a forward radiative-transfer operator, and no such operator exists on the history-import lane; this product is served only from a fetched GRIB store. The nearest stored quantity on this lane is top-of-atmosphere outgoing longwave radiation, drawn with --products var:wrf_olr, which is a flux in W m-2 and NOT a brightness temperature: the two are different quantities and one must not be read as the other.
unavailable.theta_e_2m_10m_winds: The plots show temperature, dewpoint and winds separately. The current WOOF history renderer does not calculate 2 m equivalent potential temperature; that quantity requires separate analysis.
unavailable.visibility: Low cloud cover and near-surface humidity describe the fog environment, not visibility distance. Visibility and verified fog boundaries require separate analysis or observations.
unavailable.wind_chill_2m: Air temperature and 10 m wind are shown separately. Wind chill is not calculated by this history-rendering path and requires separate analysis.
